The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: a plant eaten as food.

draft.emotion: fresh and wholesome, planning a healthy meal
notes: Often used as an uncountable singular ('comer verdura') or in the plural ('las verduras') to mean vegetables in general.

senses.definition: A plant or part of a plant, especially a green one, eaten as savoury food.

examples.text: Es muy importante comer verdura todos los días.
examples.translation: It is very important to eat vegetables every day.

draftBefore.emotion: fresh and wholesome, planning a healthy meal
notes: Often used in the plural (verduras) to refer to vegetables in general.
Do not confuse with 'la fruta', which refers to sweet plant parts usually eaten as dessert.

senses.definition: A plant or part of a plant used as food, cooked or raw.

examples.text: Es muy importante comer toda la verdura del plato.
examples.translation: It is very important to eat all the vegetables on the plate.
examples.emotion: encouraging and firm, urging someone to finish their meal

senses.definition: Fresh green foliage or plants collectively.

examples.text: Después de las lluvias, el campo recuperó toda su verdura.
examples.translation: After the rains, the countryside recovered all its greenery.
examples.emotion: admiring and peaceful, looking at a lush landscape

faults.quote: Fresh green foliage or plants collectively.
faults.why: Literary/poetic sense not needed at A2; everyday word for greenery is 'verdor' or 'vegetación'.

faults.quote: Do not confuse with 'la fruta', which refers to sweet plant parts
faults.why: Pointless note; learners do not confuse 'verdura' with 'fruta'.
